difficulty_reason: The author extends modal frame-algebra duality from functions to proof-relevant relations. The construction characterizes simulatory and cosimulatory algebraic relations, establishes fullness and essential surjectivity of the lower lifting using atoms, and passes to bisimulations through the relational converse. The hard content is the relational modal equivalence and its reconstructed predicate relation, rather than the standard object-level Thomason theorem. Tarski and simulation-only stages remain support within this one counted duality.
